# routeros_mpls_ldp_local_mapping (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_mpls_ldp_local_mapping" "mapping" {
  comment     = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  disabled    = true
  dst_address = "192.0.2.1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `dst_address` (String) Prefix the local label is bound to, written as `address/prefix-length`. Both IPv4 and IPv6 prefixes are accepted.
- `label` (String) Label advertised for the prefix. Either a label number (the console grammar accepts 16..1048576) or one of the reserved names `alert`, `expl-null`, `expl-null6`, `impl-null`.
- `vrf` (String) The VRF table this resource operates on.

### Read-Only

- `adv_path` (String) Advertised path, filled in by the router.
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `egress` (Boolean) Whether this router is the egress LSR for the prefix.
- `gateway` (Boolean) Whether the mapping is installed towards a gateway.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
- `local` (Boolean) Whether the mapping is originated locally.
- `peers` (String) Peers the mapping has been advertised to, in the `address:label-space` notation.
- `pw_fec` (String) Pseudowire FEC of the mapping, set for the VPLS pseudowire bindings.
- `vpls` (Boolean) Whether the mapping belongs to a VPLS pseudowire.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/mpls/ldp/local-mapping get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_mpls_ldp_local_mapping.mapping "*1"
```
